monthlyReport.subject: [vana-dash] Monthly report {{month}}
monthlyReport.body: The monthly report for {{month}} is attached (PDF).

efactura.rejectedBody2: Check the XML in VanaDash → Invoices → Issued and resend it after correcting.
efactura.pdfFailedBody1: Invoice {{documentNumber}} was validated by ANAF but generating the PDF failed.
efactura.pdfFailedBody2: Send it to the client by hand after you solve the problem. Error: {{err}}
efactura.noPdfBody1: Invoice {{documentNumber}} was validated by ANAF but the PDF could not be generated
efactura.noPdfBody2: (Chromium unavailable). Send it to the client by hand.

invite.subject: You have been given access to VanaDash
invite.added: You were added to the VanaDash team, the internal app of Vanadium Systems.
invite.choosePassword: Choose your password here, then you are in:
invite.validity: The link is valid for 72 hours. If you were not expecting it, ignore it; another one can be requested from the admin.

reset.subject: VanaDash password reset
reset.requested: A password reset was requested for your VanaDash account. Choose a new one here:
reset.validitySelf:
The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once. If you did not request it,
ignore it and tell the administrator.
reset.validityByAdmin:
The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once. If you did not request it,
tell the administrator: change the password and do not use the link.

booking.scheduled: The call with Vanadium Systems is scheduled for {{label}} (Romanian time), 30 minutes.
booking.linkLater: You will get the call link by email before the meeting.
booking.cancelHere: If you can no longer make it, cancel here: {{cancelUrl}}
booking.cancelledByVisitor: The call of {{label}} is canceled. If you want another time, you can pick one again on vanadium.systems.
booking.cancelledByOwner: Unfortunately I have to cancel the call of {{label}}. I will write to you separately to find another time.

support.answerFromVanadium: You have an answer from Vanadium:

anaf.reauthBody1: The ANAF refresh token has expired or was revoked ({{reason}}).
anaf.reauthBody2: Go to VanaDash → Invoices → Settings and redo the consent with the digital certificate.

revolut.reauthBody1: The Revolut refresh token for the account "{{name}}" has expired or was revoked ({{reason}}).
revolut.reauthBody2: Go to VanaDash → Reconciliation → Bank account settings and redo the OAuth consent in the browser.
